en: The sea is rising again. I might only have one day left before it’s all gone. I better go look for more resources before it gets dark.
How on earth… Who built this?

This is a global message to all remaining people of this world. The final GEP spaceship will be departing from Earth on 31 March 1949 at midday. 
Please arrange evacuation rafts from your location to ensure you arrive at Port Phillip. This is the final ship. We repeat. This is the final ship.
